user.title: Connect to the WhatsApp bridge
user.description: Normally the WhatsApp Bridge add-on is discovered automatically. For a bridge outside Home Assistant enter its WebSocket URL and access token (file auth_token in the bridge's data directory, or the AUTH_TOKEN you set).

hassio_confirm.title: WhatsApp Bridge add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the WhatsApp Bridge add-on? Afterwards a notification shows the QR code to link your WhatsApp account.

reauth_confirm.title: WhatsApp bridge access token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host} rejected the access token, or the integration was set up before the bridge required one. Enter the token (add-on: file /data/auth_token, or the add-on option auth_token).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Is the add-on running and the URL right?
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the access token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

_.name: WhatsApp message received
_.description: Triggers when a WhatsApp message is received.

from_number.name: From number
from_number.description: Sender's phone number in international format, without '+'.
